name: codex-navigator
description: Codex Desktop 长对话导航增强（Explodex 插件 + 本地 SQLite 索引）。不修改 Codex.app / ChatGPT.app。

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && npm run build:plugin && npm run build:preview
scripts.build:plugin: esbuild packages/plugin/src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/plugin/index.js && cp packages/plugin/plugin.json dist/plugin/plugin.json && cp packages/plugin/README.md dist/plugin/README.md
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/packages/core/src/persistence/schema.test.js dist/packages/core/src/adapters/codex-current.test.js dist/packages/core/src/appserver/client.test.js dist/packages/core/src/hash.test.js dist/packages/core/src/reading/restore.test.js dist/packages/core/src/reading/progress.test.js dist/packages/core/src/keymap/shortcuts.test.js dist/packages/core/src/preview-contract.test.js dist/packages/core/src/bookmarks/types.test.js dist/packages/core/src/outline/headings.test.js dist/packages/core/src/search/search.test.js dist/packages/core/src/follow/follow.test.js dist/packages/core/src/export/export.test.js dist/packages/core/src/discovery/local-history.test.js dist/packages/core/src/quota/session-quota.test.js dist/packages/core/src/quota/codex-rate-limits.test.js dist/packages/core/src/quota/native-rate-limits.test.js dist/packages/core/src/quota/reset-time.test.js dist/packages/core/src/navigation/session.test.js scripts/appserver-history-client.test.mjs scripts/quota-feed.test.mjs scripts/renderer-connection.test.mjs scripts/check-session-health.test.mjs scripts/usage-placement.test.mjs plugins/navigator-iframe-probe/server.test.mjs plugins/navigator-iframe-probe/chat-probe-server.test.mjs dist/packages/core/src/protection/controller.test.js scripts/launcher-resolver.test.mjs dist/packages/core/src/chat/history.test.js
scripts.land:all: tsc -p tsconfig.json && CODEX_NAV_READ_HISTORY=1 CODEX_NAV_LAND_ALL=1 node scripts/land-real-anchors.mjs
scripts.preview: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:preview && node scripts/preview-server.mjs
